us.h: Thanksgiving storm to lash East Coast with wind, flooding
us.s: A strengthening coastal storm brings rain and coastal flooding to the Southeast today, then peaks Thursday from the mid-Atlantic to New England with 1-4 inches of rain and gusts of 60 mph or more. St. Louis faces heavy snow.

us.h: Sullivan concedes Alaska Senate seat to Peltola
us.s: Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan conceded a day after Alaska certified Democrat Mary Peltola's roughly 4-point win, a flip that was part of a nine-seat Democratic Senate gain this cycle.

us.h: Abrego Garcia voluntarily leaves U.S. for Spain
us.s: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, wrongly deported to El Salvador in 2025 and later returned, departed for Spain after a long legal fight. His lawyers call it temporary; DHS labeled it self-deportation.

us.h: Schumer accuses Nvidia's Huang of breaking export law
us.s: Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer claimed the newly reinstated Nvidia CEO shipped advanced chips to China in violation of U.S. export controls. It is a political accusation, not a legal finding; Nvidia had not commented.

world.h: US proposes new tariffs on China, EU and 12 others
world.s: After an eight-month probe into industrial overcapacity, USTR proposed tariffs on 14 economies, with China's 20% rate the highest. A comment period and hearing mean they likely won't take effect before January 2027.

world.h: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi refinery, Riyadh financial district
world.s: Yemen's Houthis said they hit the Ras Tanura refinery, Saudi Arabia's largest, and Riyadh's financial district. The Saudi-led coalition said it downed four drones. Saudi civil defence said a strike on a Riyadh tower wounded 11 on Tuesday.

world.h: Putin vows retaliation over Ukrainian refinery strikes
world.s: Putin said Ukraine keeps hitting Russian refineries despite Trump asking it to stop, and called retaliation inevitable. Industry sources say the drone attacks have cut Russian refining throughput by about 45% since late October.

world.h: Solomon Islands signs security treaty with Australia
world.s: The new treaty bars foreign military bases in Solomon Islands and makes Australia its main security partner. The ABC reports Honiara plans to let its 2022 China policing pact lapse in 2027.

world.h: RSF drone strikes kill 19 civilians in Sudan's Blue Nile
world.s: A rights group says paramilitary drones struck homes in Damazin, killing 19 people, and wounded five in Roseires. The group says the dam and power facilities were also targeted, which could disrupt electricity across the state.

world.h: Pakistani becomes first foreigner aboard China's space station
world.s: Shenzhou-24 launched from Jiuquan and docked with Tiangong carrying Zeeshan Ali, Pakistan's first astronaut. He will spend about a week running experiments with two Chinese crewmates.

tech.h: Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after 24-hour Microsoft 365 outage
tech.s: Internal memos reviewed by Reuters show Microsoft overhauling outage prevention after the November 12-13 failure hit Outlook, Teams and Exchange. It now aims to resolve future incidents worldwide within an hour.

tech.h: US jury convicts Huawei of trade secret conspiracy, fraud
tech.s: A New York federal jury found Huawei guilty of conspiring to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud but acquitted it of racketeering conspiracy. Huawei plans to appeal, and China called the case economic bullying.

tech.h: Dell raises forecast again on record AI server demand
tech.s: Dell lifted its fiscal-year revenue outlook to $202 billion after record third-quarter sales of $54.9 billion and a $132.3 billion AI server backlog. It expects the memory chip shortage to last into 2027.

tech.h: Huang apologizes to Nvidia staff; shares slide after rally
tech.s: At his first all-hands since being reinstated, Jensen Huang apologized for violating the code of conduct, according to Bloomberg. Nvidia stock fell more than 7% Tuesday after Monday's nearly 31% jump.

tech.h: Shein to pay $100 million to settle FTC claims
tech.s: The FTC alleges Shein misled US shoppers about shipping times, suppressed negative reviews and made questionable sourcing claims. The money would go to consumer refunds once a judge approves the deal.

tech.h: Tidal to remove fully AI-generated music from December 9
tech.s: Tidal will delete about 27 million wholly AI-generated tracks and reject new uploads of them. It says 43% of tracks delivered in the past 90 days were entirely AI-made. AI-assisted music stays allowed.

talking.h: Bears-Lions, Chiefs-Bills headline NFL Thanksgiving slate
talking.s: Holiday football starts tonight with Packers at Rams on Netflix, then Thursday brings Bears at Lions, Eagles at Cowboys, and a Mahomes-Allen showdown as Kansas City visits 9-1 Buffalo.

talking.h: Wind threatens Macy's parade balloons in NYC
talking.s: With gusts of 45-55 mph forecast Thursday, organizers are weighing schedule and balloon changes; the NYPD grounds balloons if gusts top 34 mph, which has happened for weather only once, in 1971.

talking.h: Trump sets Medal of Freedom honor for Giuliani
talking.s: Trump scheduled an Oval Office ceremony Tuesday to give the nation's top civilian honor to Rudy Giuliani, his former lawyer, who was disbarred and hit with a $148 million defamation judgment after the 2020 election.

coming.h: Q3 GDP revision and October PCE inflation data
coming.s: The Commerce Department releases its second estimate of third-quarter GDP and October personal income and spending, including the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, at 8:30 a.m. ET.

coming.h: Thanksgiving: storm peaks, stock markets closed
coming.s: U.S. stock markets are closed for the holiday as the East Coast storm hits hardest, with possible delays at airports from Washington to Boston.
Stock markets close at 1 p.m. ET as retailers kick off the holiday shopping season.

coming.h: Protected status for Lebanese immigrants expires
coming.s: Temporary protected status for Lebanese nationals in the U.S. ends Friday unless extended; a House bill co-sponsored by Rep. Rashida Tlaib seeks to prolong it.
The biggest online shopping day of the year caps the Thanksgiving weekend retail rush.
